title: Core with lifts + stair punched through the floor stack
prompt: The scene contains a 4-storey massing (30m x 18m, ground 4200mm, uppers 3600mm) with derived slabs. Add a building core near the plate centroid: perimeter walls 200mm thick, two lifts and a stair, full building height (15000mm). Punch the core shafts through the massing and every slab so the voids are real. Core walls on 'Core::Walls'.
